amendment.classification: GOVERNED DEPENDENCY AMENDMENT - not a resolution detail
amendment.selection_rationale: Smallest runtime surface of the resolvable candidates: the 3.x line drops pytz and tzdata. Because no bound evaluator module imports pandas, the 2.x-vs-3.x behavioural differences do not bear on the evaluator.
amendment.why_added: P10 requires a pandas_version binding: NumericRuntimeIdentityManifest_v1.0.json lists 'pandas version' among required_bindings, and _versions() REFUSES with required_package_missing when pandas is absent. No lock declared it and none of the 21 bound evaluator modules import it.
amendment.why_added_rather_than_removed_from_the_s: Dropping pandas from required_bindings would reduce P10 from 17 bindings to 16. Execution-sequencing direction D-S1 forbids weakening the 17-binding requirement, so the dependency set was amended instead of the preregistered spec.
